document.summary: Repair plan for the five user-reported problems from the 2026-09-08 feedback round: (S1) an explicit 8BitDo View/Back binding for "save clip" does nothing while the same button works for screenshot/overlay; (S2) no or late confirmation that a clip was actually saved; (S3) capture sounds are too quiet; (S4) the yellow Windows capture border is still visible; (S5) the app does not reopen on the last tab. It is derived from the GPT static analysis package (`.claude-gui-temp/gpt-analysis/`, baseline `547ac25`) and independently re-verified against the code on `dev`; two GPT claims were refuted and the affected tasks were rewritten (see "Corrections to the GPT draft"). Nothing here is implemented yet: all items are todo at 0%.
document.expected_outcome:
A controller "save clip" press is traceable end to end by request id and produces feedback within 100 ms; existing clips can never be overwritten or deleted by a later save and an export survives a game switch; the buffer reports its real state; screenshot and clip failures are always visible; the capture border is hidden where Windows allows it and honestly reported where it does not; the app reopens on the last page, category, filter and monitor; capture sounds are audible with their own level; everything is localized, covered by automated acceptance and confirmed on the reporter's hardware.

> **Goal:** close the 2026-09-08 feedback round with code-verified fixes, regression tests and hardware confirmation, without touching the verified frame-pump hot path.
> **Scope:** `src/input/` (diagnostics, editor guards, override lookup), `src/capture/FramePumpService`, `SegmentRecorder`, `CapturePublisher`, `src/notify/`, `src/sound/`, `src/ui/` (Main.qml, SettingsView.qml, AppController), `src/app/App.cpp`, WGC shims, tests, docs, 16 locale catalogs.
> **Safety:** project rules apply to every batch: VERSION patch bump on the 0.7.x line, CHANGELOG entry, docs update, tracker tick, build + launch + `build/gamehq-data/logs/gamehq.log` check, commit to `dev` only. Never inject into game processes; never modify imported folders; favorites are never auto-deleted. Any resolver or backend change requires a real-pad re-verify (DualSense + XInput pad).

items.agent_notes:
Context: Matrix built 2026-09-08 from static evidence on dev @547ac25 (VERSION 0.7.7). No code changed, no build run.

Baseline (dev box): Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200 -> >=22000, so IGraphicsCaptureSession3 (border API) exists here. Build dir is `out` (start.bat: cmake -S . -B out -G Ninja), NOT `build`; fix the p2-1 validation-profile string. Config defaults (ConfigManager.cpp:23-54): replay.auto=true, replay.clip_sound=true, replay.clip_notify=true, capture.screenshot_sound=true, notifications enabled=true, sounds.volume=80.

S1 View/Back save does nothing - reporter-only, NOT reproduced locally.
FACTS (code): defaults BindingResolver.cpp:243-249 bind screenshot=Capture tap1, save_replay=Capture hold, overlay=Capture tap2. XInputDevice.cpp:193 and WinMMDevice.cpp:269 publish the pad's Share/Back as ControlId::ViewBack, never Capture. InputEngine.cpp:993 enters the legacy Capture alias only when ProviderIntegration::allowsLegacyViewFallback() holds: XInput provider AND xinput.slot* id AND the logical controller lacks SystemShare AND hasExplicitViewBinding()==false. FramePumpWorker::saveGuard rejects a save when the recorder is inactive, an export is busy, or an update is pending, and emits clipFailed.
FACT (reporter): View/Back works when explicitly mapped to screenshot and to opening the interface; the same explicit mapping for save clip does nothing. That proves ViewBack edges reach the runtime and that explicit bindings DO resolve for this profile - so the failure looks action-specific.
NOT PROVEN: that the legacy Capture alias is live (working screenshot/overlay are explained by their own explicit mappings), and therefore NOT proven that the save_replay override is invisible under the resolved profile. Do not treat profile mismatch as inferred fact.
HYPOTHESES, equally ranked until p1-2 traces a real press: H-A action/gesture semantics - the save_replay row resolves under a different gesture (hold vs tap), hold ms, or scope than the reporter performs. H-B downstream rejection - the binding fires but saveGuard refuses (buffer not armed / export busy) and the only feedback is a toast plus an error sound, which S2 and S3 make easy to miss. H-C override lookup - the save_replay row alone is stored under a device_group/device_profile the runtime does not resolve. p1-2 must log request id, resolved profile, matched binding, gesture and the saveGuard outcome to separate these.

S2 no/late save confirmation (CONFIRMED in code, reproducible locally). App.cpp:250-253 connects clipSaving to an EMPTY lambda: zero acknowledgement at press time; the user sees nothing until the whole remux finishes. App.cpp:254-270 clipSaved -> commitClip + replay_saved sound + toast (gated by notifications enabled + replay.clip_notify). App.cpp:271+ clipFailed -> error sound + toast (gated by notifications enabled only).

S3 sounds too quiet (CONFIRMED). SoundEngine.cpp:39 maps sounds.volume (default 80) linearly to QSoundEffect volume; linear 0.8 is perceptually quiet against game audio and there is no separate capture-feedback level. Compounds S1/S2: the error sound is often the only failure signal.

S4 yellow border (CONFIRMED as best-effort). FramePumpService.cpp:491-503 QIs IGraphicsCaptureSession3 and calls put_IsBorderRequired(0); on QI failure or a failed hr it only logs and the border stays, with no user-visible explanation and no setting. p4-1 must establish the real call-order/access requirement.

S5 last tab not restored (CONFIRMED, two separate defects). (a) No last-view persistence exists: ConfigKeys.h has no page/category/filter key and Main.qml has no restore path. (b) Main.qml:19-26 restores x/y only when the stored value is >=0, so a window on a monitor left of or above the primary (negative coords) is silently re-centered on the primary; Main.qml:249-255 persists ui.window_x/y/width/height/zoom_level.

State: BLOCKED at 70%. S2-S5 rows complete from code; S1 rows carry facts, an explicit not-proven list and three ranked hypotheses.
Missing (reporter-only, do NOT guess): gamehq.log for a failing save; winver; 8BitDo model + transport + mode (XInput/DInput/BT); replay.auto, replay.clip_notify, replay.clip_sound, capture.screenshot_sound, sounds.volume values; the binding_overrides row for global.save_replay (device_group, device_profile, control, gesture, hold ms).
Gotchas: never modify the reporter's DB - request an export. Next: collect the missing evidence, then p1-2.

Update 2026-09-09: p1-2 no longer depends on this item (owner-approved). The request-id trace and profile-aware binding diagnostics shipped in 3c721d4 (v0.7.17) and are the tooling that will produce the missing S1 evidence. This item stays blocked purely on the reporter's log and binding export.

items.description: Reproduce S1 on real hardware with the p1-2 trace and rank the hypotheses until one is confirmed by log evidence.

items.agent_notes: Hypotheses in likelihood order. H1 gesture mismatch: `global.save_replay` ships as Capture+Hold 2000 ms (`BindingResolver.cpp:243`, `CaptureDatabase.cpp:387`); if the rebind kept Hold, a View tap never crosses the threshold while screenshot (Tap) fires instantly. H2 profile mismatch: the override was saved under one device profile (USB/XInput slot vs BT/WinMM/GameInput identity) and the pad plays under another, so `effectiveBindings(deviceProfile)` lacks it; compare the row's device_profile with the runtime profile from the p1-2 log. H3 action fired, save failed downstream: `replay.auto` off arms a cold buffer (`FramePumpService.cpp:1015-1039`); failures are visible only with `replay.clip_notify` on; busy guard emits clipFailed (`735-739`). H4 legacy alias: unhandled ViewBack with no explicit View binding synthesizes a Capture press (`InputEngine.cpp:987-999`), only reachable as a consequence of H2. Refuted: XInput publishes Back as ControlId::ViewBack (`XInputDevice.cpp:193`). Test on the 8BitDo in each transport plus DualSense and an Xbox pad.

items.title: Collision-safe clip and thumbnail publishing
items.description: Route final clip and thumbnail names through CapturePublisher reserve/publish so an existing file can never be deleted or overwritten by a later save.
items.why: The final name has second resolution and QFile::remove runs before the rename, while millisecond-unique names only protect ring segments.
items.done_when: Two saves within one second produce two files, the older is byte-identical, and a unit test proves no delete of a pre-existing target.
items.result: Two clips saved in the same second now keep both files; a failed save can no longer delete an existing clip.
items.agent_notes:
Context: p2-1 done on dev @2433d63, VERSION 0.7.8 (CHANGELOG + docs/capture-engine.md + tracker updated in the same commit).

What changed: FramePumpWorker::saveReplayOnWorker() now mkpaths the Clips dir, then CapturePublisher::reserve(clipsDir, "yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss", ".mp4") BEFORE any write; a second save in the same second gets <stamp>_2.mp4. thumbPath comes from the new CapturePublisher::companionPath(finalPath, thumbnailsDir, "_clip.png"), so the preview inherits the _2 and keeps the "<clip base>_clip.png" shape ThumbnailService::ensureThumbnail() reattaches. runExport() takes the Reservation instead of an outPath; concat writes into reservation.pendingPath (no more <out>.partial), success calls publish(), every failure path calls discard(). Both QFile::remove(outPath) calls (publish step and the finished-handler failure branch) are DELETED - that was the data loss. FramePumpService's constructor sweeps abandoned *.part under clipsBaseRoot (kStaleClipPartMaxAgeSecs = 600), mirroring ScreenshotService.

MF proof (reviewer's precondition): standalone probe with the project MinGW showed MFCreateSinkWriterFromURL + AddStream + BeginWriting all hr=0x0 on a pre-created reservation file, both empty and with leftover bytes, and the file is truncated to 0 and keeps its path. So the reserved .part is safe to hand to the sink writer and the name stays claimed for the whole export.

Tests: 3 new cases in tests/tst_capturepublisher.cpp - twoClipSavesInsideOneSecondBothSurvive (two files, older byte-identical), aFailedExportNeverDeletesAnExistingClip (discard leaves a published clip untouched), aThumbnailFollowsTheNameItsClipWasGiven (companion inherits _2). Suite green via ctest in a GAMEHQ_BUILD_TESTS=ON tree; the `out` tree builds the full GameHQ target clean.

Gotchas: tests need a separate configure with -DGAMEHQ_BUILD_TESTS=ON (the `out` dev tree has it OFF); build dir is `out`, not `build`. Test exes only run through ctest (PATH modification for Qt DLLs).

Pending at the p2 group milestone (batched, not part of this item): launch the app, save two clips back to back on a real game, confirm two MP4s + two thumbnails in the gallery and the ReplaySave publish lines in build/gamehq-data/logs/gamehq.log.

Context: entry points audited in code on 2026-09-08 at HEAD 493c4dd.
- Cold launch: Main.qml:58-59 settingsOpen/helpOpen default false; AppController.h:212-213 m_category="all", m_gameId=-1; SettingsView.qml:30 reads ui.settings_category as an INDEX.
- App::showWindow (App.cpp:597-609) only show/raise/activate, no view state touched. toggleDesktopWindow and focusDesktopWindow reuse it.
- Tray (TrayIcon.cpp:114,134-139): menu item and single/double click both emit openGalleryRequested, wired to showWindow (App.cpp:341) -> no reset today.
- App::openGallery (App.cpp:670-682, from --open-gallery / IntegrationService.cpp:151) forces setCategory("all") (drops gameId) and closes settings+help.
- Saved-clip toast: ToastWindow.qml delegates are dismiss-only, no click target exists yet; tray showNotification (TrayIcon.cpp:150) never connects messageClicked.

RULES TABLE (agreed; p5-2 implements it)
| # | Entry point | Rule |
| R1 | Cold launch | Restore last page, last settings category and last gallery filter. Help is never restored; a saved "help" page collapses to gallery. |
| R2 | showWindow (PS-hold summon, --activate, desktop toggle) | Pure raise. Never changes page, category or filter. |
| R3 | Tray open (menu item, single and double click) | Same as R2: restore whatever was last shown, no forced reset. |
| R4 | openGallery (--open-gallery second instance) | Explicit gallery intent: close settings/help and land on gallery, but keep the saved gallery filter. Remove the setCategory("all") reset. |
| R5 | Saved-clip toast click (decision D1, 2026-09-08) | One-shot jump: open gallery, filter to the new clip's game and category, select and reveal the clip. The jump is TRANSIENT - it must not overwrite persisted last-view state, so the next ordinary open restores the saved view. |
| R6 | Settings category | Persist as a stable key string in ui.settings_category ("general","capture","replay","input","library","notifications_sound","advanced","about"). Migrate a legacy integer by index once; unknown key -> General. Reordering categories must not shift the restored one. |
| R7 | Gallery filter | Persist ui.gallery_filter_category (default "all") and ui.gallery_filter_game (int game id, -1 = all games). On restore, validate the game still exists in listGames(); otherwise fall back to "all"/-1. |
| R8 | Overlay filter per game | The game binding always follows the foreground game and is never restored. Only the category is remembered per game in ui.overlay_filter.<gameId>; unknown or missing entry -> "all". |
| R9 | Precedence | Explicit navigation intent (R5 toast jump, R4 --open-gallery) > restored state > defaults. |
| R10 | Write timing | Persist on change via app.setConfig (the SettingsView.qml:45 pattern) plus a save on window hide and on quit. "Reset all settings" clears ui.* so the next open falls back to defaults. |

Gotchas: R5 must stay transient or it silently rewrites the user's filter; R6 needs the one-time int->key migration or everyone lands on the wrong category after the rename; R8 must not be keyed by game name (ids only).
